name: RV-over-IV cheap-gamma breakout — ADX-confirmed trend (4h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the 4h RV>IV cheap-gamma breakout, confirming the directional move with ADX trend strength instead of a raw return leg — a structurally different momentum gauge so the vol cross is not just re-reading recent return): when vol_realized crosses ABOVE dvol, realized outruns implied — dealers are under-hedged and a genuine directional move is underway; realized-vol continuation is stickier here (vol clustering). We require a CONFIRMED trend (adx above a fitted floor) so we ride expansion with a real trend, not a one-bar spike. Entry: vol_realized clears a fitted floor AND dvol below a fitted ceiling (implied lagging -> options cheap) AND adx above a fitted floor (trend confirmed). The other side is complacent vol sellers short gamma into the move, forced to buy spot to hedge -> their hedging flow fuels the continuation. OPPOSITE regime to VRP-harvest (inverted sign on the same IV/RV pair) -> not double-counted. Exit: adx crosses down (the trend is dying) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain ADX-trend long (drop the RV>IV cross) matches the deflated Sharpe, the vol dislocation adds no timing edge and this is the already-tested adx-trend-follow. DISCONFIRMER 2: if dropping the dvol-ceiling leg (keep only rv-floor + adx) matches it, the IMPLIED side is inert and the 'cheap gamma' claim is unsupported. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points -> paper-only.
catalyst: realized vol overtaking implied inside a confirmed ADX trend
